name: Twenty-Nine
description: Twenty-Nine is a trick-taking card game for four players in partnerships. Played with 32 cards; Jack and Nine rank high in every suit. Popular in India, Bangladesh, and Nepal; descended from the European Jass family.

overview.description: Twenty-Nine is a trick-taking card game for four players in partnerships. Played with 32 cards; Jack and Nine rank high in every suit. Popular in India, Bangladesh, and Nepal; descended from the European Jass family.

history.origins:
Country/Region of Origin: India, Bangladesh, Nepal (South Asia). Descended from the European Jass family (Netherlands), likely brought to the Indian subcontinent by Dutch traders.
Time Period: Traditional; widely documented in card-game literature from the 2000s.
Historical Development: South Asian trick-taking game; Jack and Nine rank high in every suit; related to Twenty-Eight, Fifty-Six, 304.
Cultural Significance: Popular partnership game across northern India, Bangladesh, and Nepal.
timeline: Modern Era: Continues to be played worldwide
